---
title: "Research"
---

**LEDT** carries out research on the knowledge, documentation and conservation of Amazonian biodiversity, integrating ecology, dendrology, taxonomy and innovative tools for the study of tropical trees.

### Projects

The laboratory currently takes part in the following research projects:

-   ***Ecclinusa*****:** Building a near-infrared spectral library to reveal new species of *Ecclinusa* (Sapotaceae, Chrysophylloideae) in South America \| 2025-2026 \| IAPT 2025 round \| PI: Caroline C. Vasconcelos (UFAM, Brazil).

-   **SpectraPop:** Popularizing the use of the Species Spectral Signature for the identification of trees in Sustainable Forest Management in the Amazon \| 2025-2026 \| FAPEAM \| 01.02.016301.04984/2024-17 \| PI: Flávia Machado Durgante (INPA, Brazil).

-   **HerbSpectra-Amazônia:** Amazon Network of Spectral Herbaria: Spectroscopy and artificial intelligence for the automated identification of biodiversity in Amazonian herbaria \| 2025-2027 \| CNPq 385465/2025-4 \| PI: Flávia Machado Durgante (INPA, Brazil).

-   **Tropecolnet:** Characterizing the role of interacting species, the drivers and the structure of plant-frugivore ecological networks along a defaunation gradient in tropical forests \| 2023-2026 \| PID2022-138272NA-I00 \| PI: Ana Benítez-Lopez (MNCN-CSIC, Spain).

-   **Neoshortfall:** Addressing biodiversity shortfalls in Neotropical hyperdiverse forests to improve our understanding of the effects of defaunation on phenotypic traits, species assemblages and biotic interactions \| PI: Ana Benítez-Lopez (MNCN-CSIC, Spain).

-   **Revelando os Incógnitos:** epiphytes, insects and fungi associated with the várzea tree flora in the eastern Amazon \| 2024-2027 \| CNPq 400738/2024-4 \| PI: Marcelino Carneiro Guedes (Embrapa Amapá, Brazil).

### Collaboration networks

LEDT is part of national and international networks devoted to the study of plant biodiversity, herbaria and spectroscopy:

-   [Amazon Tree Diversity Network (ATDN)](https://sites.google.com/naturalis.nl/amazon-tree-diversity-network/homepage)
-   [International Herbarium Spectral Digitization Working Group (IHerbSpec)](https://iherbspec.github.io/)
-   [Sapotaceae Taxonomic Expert Network – World Flora Online (TEN/WFO)](https://about.worldfloraonline.org/tens/sapotaceae)
-   [Tropical Seed Trait Database (TSTD)](https://eeslufmg.weebly.com/tstd.html)
